name: Dracopelta
isnote: Treated as an ankylosaurian; family-level placement of this fragmentary Late Jurassic taxon differs between analyses (Arbour 2015 and others cited in the revision).
sum: Dracopelta is a Late Jurassic ankylosaur from the Lourinhã Formation of Portugal, known from a partial skeleton.
holotype: MG 3 (formerly IGM 5787), with dorsal vertebrae, articulated ribs, osteoderms and an incomplete autopodium — Lourinhã Formation, near Praia da Assenta, Portugal.
material: Holotype only, with additional material under description.
biology: Armoured herbivore; no behavioural data in the sources used.
author: Galton 1980

sources.text: M. Galton, Peter 1980. Partial skeleton of ''Dracopelta zbyszewskii'' n. gen. And N. SP., an ankylosaurian dinosaur from the Upper Jurassic of Portugal. Geobios 13(3): 451–457. doi:10.1016/S0016-6995(80)80081-7
